description: React component for a Todo list application with features including task persistence using localStorage, task toggling, addition, deletion, and accessibility features such as ARIA roles and labels. It renders a UI with a list of tasks, a header showing progress, and a floating action button to add new tasks via modal dialog.

methods.name: toggleTask
methods.description: Toggles a task’s completion state by id.

methods.name: closeAddDialog
methods.description: Closes the add-task dialog and resets the input.

methods.name: confirmAddTask
methods.description: Confirms and adds a new task if the title is non-empty.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task by its id.
